messages.author: 9783d9fe56013431
messages.subject: geom_hline and variable ranges
parts:
Hi.

I've uploaded an example file ("hlinerange.txt")

What I'd like to achieve is horizontal lines that have y-intercepts at
"percent" but whose ranges are defined by "start" and "stop". (I have
many hundreds of these points to plot)

I don't see options within geom_hline that would allow a line to have
a restricted range. Is there such an option? And if not, would another
geom work for this problem?

Thank you.
Squid.

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: geom_hline and variable ranges
parts:
Hi Squid, have a look at geom_segment. I think that's what you are looking for. In your case, I think y and yend will have the same values while x and xend will be start and stop.
Hope it helps.
Luciano
